[[Fire Lord]] is a [[Djinn]] [[boss]] that must be defeated to acquire its essence for [[Library Envoy Chukeht]].

== Locations ==
* [[Vabbi]]
** {{NPC location|The Hidden City of Ahdashim}} (only during [[Gift of the Djinn]])

== Skills ==
* {{Skill icon|Fire Attunement}}
* {{Skill icon|Fire Storm}}
* {{Skill icon|Fireball}}
* {{Skill icon|Immolate}}
* {{Skill icon|Mind Burn}} ([[elite]])

== Notes ==
* The djinn does not actually drop an essence that needs to be picked up. Killing it will immediately update the quest.
